# Bloop Animation

> > Bloop Animation is an online animation education platform offering courses in 2D, 3D, and stop motion animation, featuring software tutorials for Blender, Maya, After Effects, and other industry tools.

Founded by animator and educator Morr Meroz, Bloop Animation provides comprehensive animation training through their All Access Pass course library, produces original animated short films like Tasteful and LIFT UP, and offers guidance on animation software, storytelling techniques, and career development for aspiring animators.

## Key Topics

- 3D Animation
- 2D Animation
- Stop Motion
- Character Animation
- Storyboarding
- Animation Software
- Blender
- Maya
- After Effects
- Pixar Storytelling
- Animated Short Films
- Animation Courses
- Screenwriting
- Film Festivals
- Tasteful (Original Film)

## Animation Courses & Training

- [AAA-courses - Bloop Animation](https://www.bloopanimation.com/aaa-courses): All Access Pass library of animation courses in 2D, 3D, and stop motion
- [Creating a Story - the Pixar Way - Bloop Animation](https://www.bloopanimation.com/creating-a-story-the-pixar-way): Pixar storytelling course covering storyboarding and character animation
- [Maya Animation is Available for Purchase - Bloop Animation](https://www.bloopanimation.com/maya-animation-is-available-for-purchase): Launch announcement for Maya Animation beginner course
- [Stick Figure Animation Course - Official Announcement - Bloop Animation](https://www.bloopanimation.com/stick-figure-animation-course-official-announcement): Alan Becker stick figure animation masterclass announcement
- [2 New Animation Courses Coming Up! - Bloop Animation](https://www.bloopanimation.com/new-animation-courses-coming-up): Announcement of upcoming Flash and After Effects animation courses

## Animation Guides & Tutorials

- [How to make an animated movie](https://www.bloopanimation.com/how-to-make-an-animated-movie): Step-by-step guide to animated movie production from concept to completion
- [Animation Software: Which One Should You Use? The complete guide](https://www.bloopanimation.com/animation-software): Complete guide to animation software for 2D, 3D, and stop motion
- [2D and 3D Animation: Which to Use for Your Project? - Bloop Animation](https://www.bloopanimation.com/2d-and-3d-animation-which-to-use): Guide comparing 2D and 3D animation techniques for project planning
- [How I rendered this shot using Maya Software and no lights (Making an Animated Movie) - Bloop Animation](https://www.bloopanimation.com/lighting-and-rendering): Tutorial on rendering with Maya Software without lights using compositing
- [Best Animation Film Festivals for Submitting Your Animated Short Film](https://www.bloopanimation.com/best-animation-film-festivals): Complete guide to animation festivals and Oscar-qualifying submissions
- [ToonSquid vs. FlipaClip: Which One Should You Use? - Bloop Animation](https://www.bloopanimation.com/toonsquid-vs-flipaclip): Comparison of ToonSquid and FlipaClip iPad animation apps
